description: 《Just Dance》描寫一個人在熱鬧的派對中，透過音樂與舞蹈暫時忘卻煩惱、盡情享受當下的心情。歌中的主角因喝了太多酒而感到頭暈目眩，甚至弄丟手機與鑰匙，連自己身在何處都記不清楚。然而，她仍然沉浸在強烈的音樂節奏中，試圖以跳舞掩飾混亂與不安。歌曲以幽默、誇張的方式呈現夜生活中的狂歡、誘惑與失控，也反映人們渴望逃離現實壓力的心情。最終，《Just Dance》傳達的是放鬆、自我釋放與享受當下的渴望：即使生活偶爾變得混亂，人們仍希望透過音樂尋找片刻的自由與快樂，但狂歡背後也隱含著失去控制的風險。

vocabulary.usage: 想說某件事的數量或程度超過合適的範圍時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「A little bit too much」？
options: I put a little bit too much salt in the soup, and now it tastes bad.
The museum is a little bit too much next to the station.
She a little bit too much arrived before the show.
We have a little bit too much Monday tomorrow.
optionExplanations: 正確！鹽放得稍微太多，所以湯的味道變差。
錯誤！too much 不能用來表示位置；可以說 very close to the station。
錯誤！片語不能直接放在 arrived 前；要說 arrived a little bit too early。
錯誤！星期一不是可用 too much 表示過量的東西；可以說 We have too much work on Monday。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確！鹽放得稍微太多，所以湯的味道變差。

vocabulary.usage: 趕時間、急著走，或很多人快速往某處移動時使用。
options: The actor rushed his blue jacket because it was new.
We rushed to the airport because our flight was leaving soon.
My phone rushed at 20 percent last night.
The teacher rushed the answer on the board to mean it was correct.
optionExplanations: 錯誤！rush 不能表示穿上衣服；可說 put on his blue jacket。
正確！趕飛機時匆忙去機場，可以用 rushed to。
錯誤！手機電量下降不叫 rush；可以說 My phone battery dropped to 20 percent。
錯誤！rush 不表示核對答案；可說 checked the answer。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確！趕飛機時匆忙去機場，可以用 rushed to。

vocabulary.usage: 轉太多圈、搭車不舒服或頭暈時，可以說 feel dizzy。
options: I was dizzy because my train ticket was very cheap.
After spinning around ten times, I felt dizzy.
The concert was dizzy at seven in the evening.
He put the dizzy in his bag before class.
optionExplanations: 錯誤！票便宜不會自然地表示頭暈；dizzy 指身體的暈眩感。
正確！轉了很多圈後感到頭暈，正是 dizzy 的意思。
錯誤！不能用 dizzy 表示演唱會的開始時間；可說 started at seven。
錯誤！dizzy 是形容詞，不能當成可放進包包的物品。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確！轉了很多圈後感到頭暈，正是 dizzy 的意思。

vocabulary.usage: 看到奇怪的情況，想知道發生什麼事時使用。

錯誤！單純的價格資訊沒有顯示意外或不明情況。

vocabulary.explanation: 正確！看到大家突然跑出電影院，詢問發生什麼事很自然。

vocabulary.usage: 眼睛很累、太暈，或眼前模糊看不清楚時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「See straight」？

I can't see straight after riding that fast roller coaster.

optionExplanations: 錯誤！see straight 不能表示開始新工作；可說 start my new job。

vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Keep it cool」？

The bus went inside out when it arrived late.

optionExplanations: 正確！衣服內外穿反，標籤露出來，可以說 inside out。
錯誤！inside out 不表示把畫塗成紅色。
錯誤！公車晚到不能用 inside out；可說 The bus arrived late。
錯誤！忘記歌詞與內外翻轉沒有關係；可說 He forgot the words。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確！衣服內外穿反，標籤露出來，可以說 inside out。

vocabulary.usage: 事情太困難而不再繼續，或決定不再追求某件事時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Give up」？
options: I gave up my passport to finish the airport on time.
She gave up her birthday at six in the morning.
The puzzle was very hard, but I didn't give up.
The coach gave up the weather because it rained.
optionExplanations: 錯誤！give up 不表示完成機場；句子沒有合理意思。
錯誤！生日不是這樣使用 give up 的對象；可說 She celebrated her birthday。
正確！拼圖很難，但沒有放棄嘗試。
錯誤！天氣不是教練能這樣放棄的事；可說 The coach cancelled practice。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確！拼圖很難，但沒有放棄嘗試。

vocabulary.usage: 等待某件事發生前，先做另一件事時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「In the meantime」？
options: In the meantime is the name of our new science teacher.
I bought an in the meantime at the bookshop.
My train travels in the meantime at 100 kilometres per hour.
The doctor will arrive soon. In the meantime, please sit here.
optionExplanations: 錯誤！in the meantime 是時間片語，不是人名或職稱。
錯誤！它不是可以購買的物品，前面也不能這樣加 an。
錯誤！in the meantime 不表示速度；這裡可直接說 travels at 100 kilometres per hour。
正確！等醫生來的這段時間，先坐在這裡。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確！等醫生來的這段時間，先坐在這裡。

vocabulary.usage: 看到很驚人的表演、成果或事情時，用來表達讚嘆或驚訝。
options: I incredibled my computer before the online meeting.
We went incredible to the train station at noon.
Please put three incredibles in the shopping basket.
The young dancer gave an incredible performance, and everyone cheered.
optionExplanations: 錯誤！incredible 是形容詞，不是可以這樣使用的動詞。
錯誤！incredible 不能當作去車站的方向或方式。
錯誤！incredible 是形容詞，不能這樣當作可數商品名稱。
正確！舞者表現非常精彩，大家歡呼，很適合用 incredible。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確！舞者表現非常精彩，大家歡呼，很適合用 incredible。

questions.meaning: 唱片；錄製的歌曲
questions.usage: 談音樂時可指唱片或一首錄製好的歌曲；也有「紀錄」的其他意思。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「record」？
options: I sent a record to fix the broken window.
The doctor played a record to check my fever.
The DJ played a new record at the party.
We used a record to wash the kitchen floor.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。修窗戶不會寄送唱片作為維修方法。
錯誤。看診量體溫不會「播放唱片」；應說 checked my temperature。
正確。DJ 播放唱片／歌曲，意思自然。
錯誤。唱片不是清潔地板的工具。
questions.explanation: 正確。DJ 播放唱片／歌曲，意思自然。

questions.meaning: 旋轉；使……轉動
questions.usage: 形容唱片、陀螺或輪子轉動；也可表示快速轉身。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「spin」？
options: The dancer spun around and faced the door.
The shop spun a ticket to give us a price.
The driver spun a map to start the engine.
We spun our dinner for ten minutes to eat it.
optionExplanations: 正確。舞者原地轉身，符合 spin around。
錯誤。抽票決定價格不是 spin 的典型搭配；可說 drew a ticket。
錯誤。發動引擎不是旋轉地圖；用 started the engine。
錯誤。吃晚餐不是把晚餐旋轉；用 ate。
questions.explanation: 正確。舞者原地轉身，符合 spin around。

questions.meaning: 毒物；有害之物（歌詞中借指酒或危險誘惑）
questions.usage: 日常通常指會傷害生物的毒物；歌詞中的借喻不可當作一般「飲料」稱呼。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「poison」？
options: My father bought poison to make the flowers smell nice.
The chef added poison to make the soup taste sweet.
The bottle held poison, so we did not touch it.
That fresh fruit was poison because it was green.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。毒物不是讓花更香的材料。
錯誤。毒藥不能當甜味調味料。
正確。標明是毒物的瓶子不去觸碰，語意正確。
錯誤。水果綠色不表示必然有毒。
questions.explanation: 正確。標明是毒物的瓶子不去觸碰，語意正確。

questions.meaning: 刺（尤指植物莖上的刺）
questions.usage: 談玫瑰或其他帶刺植物時使用；可用來比喻美好事物有風險。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「thorns」？
options: Wear gloves; those roses have sharp thorns.
She put thorns in the soup to make it warm.
The thorns on the radio made the music louder.
The bike had thorns because its seat was wet.
optionExplanations: 正確。玫瑰帶有尖刺，戴手套合理。
錯誤。植物刺不是加熱湯的材料。
錯誤。收音機不會長植物刺；要調音量用 volume。
錯誤。單車座墊濕不會讓單車長刺。
questions.explanation: 正確。玫瑰帶有尖刺，戴手套合理。

questions.meaning: 商品／作品目錄
questions.usage: 查找書本、商品或展覽資料時，常用 catalogue（美式亦寫 catalog）。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「catalogue」？
options: The driver checked the catalogue to stop the rain.
I checked the catalogue to find a book about space.
She opened the catalogue to turn on the lights.
We bought a catalogue to cook the rice faster.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。查看目錄不能讓雨停。
正確。從圖書館目錄找書，是常見用法。
錯誤。目錄不能用來開燈。
錯誤。目錄不是加快煮飯速度的器具。
questions.explanation: 正確。從圖書館目錄找書，是常見用法。

questions.meaning: 缺點；瑕疵
questions.usage: 談產品、設計或計畫的問題；可用 a flaw in + 名詞。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「flaw」？
options: He put a flaw on the desk to write a note.
The train had a flaw because it left on time.
A flaw in the cake meant it tasted very good.
There was a flaw in the plan, so we changed it.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。flaw 是缺陷，不是寫字工具。
錯誤。準時出發不是缺陷。
錯誤。味道好不是缺陷的合理證據。
正確。計畫中有缺點，因此修改，意思符合。
questions.explanation: 正確。計畫中有缺點，因此修改，意思符合。

questions.meaning: 抓緊；緊緊抓住；牢牢記住想法
questions.usage: 常用 latch onto + 物件／想法；在歌詞中有成人暗示，不宜直接模仿。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「latch onto」？
options: Our team latched onto the rain to change the weather.
The baby latched onto his mom’s finger tightly.
The chef latched onto the oven to bake a cake.
The child latched onto a clock to make it ring.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。無法抓住雨來改變天氣。
正確。嬰兒緊抓手指，是自然的字面用法。
錯誤。做蛋糕需要用烤箱，不是緊抓烤箱。
錯誤。握時鐘不會因此使它響；應說 set the alarm。
questions.explanation: 正確。嬰兒緊抓手指，是自然的字面用法。

questions.meaning: 令人著迷的；催眠般的
questions.usage: 形容節奏、聲音或動作具有強烈吸引力，讓人難移開注意。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「hypnotic」？
options: Her new shoes were hypnotic because they were wet.
He called the empty room hypnotic because it was locked.
The sign was hypnotic because it had no words.
The slow music had a hypnotic rhythm.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。鞋子濕並不能說明有催眠般魅力。
錯誤。房間上鎖與令人著迷沒有直接關係。
錯誤。沒有文字不必然令人入迷，缺少吸引力情境。
正確。緩慢音樂的節奏令人入迷，搭配自然。
questions.explanation: 正確。緩慢音樂的節奏令人入迷，搭配自然。

questions.meaning: 藍圖；詳細設計圖或計畫
questions.usage: 指建築設計圖，也可比喻做事的詳細計畫。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「blueprint」？
options: I wore a blueprint to stay warm in winter.
The teacher watered a blueprint to help it grow.
The singer ate a blueprint before going on stage.
The builder checked the blueprint before work began.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。藍圖不是保暖衣物。
錯誤。藍圖不是植物，不能澆水使其生長。
錯誤。藍圖不是食物。
正確。建築工人施工前查看設計藍圖很自然。
questions.explanation: 正確。建築工人施工前查看設計藍圖很自然。

questions.meaning: 交響樂的；具交響樂風格的
questions.usage: 多形容音樂或作品，尤其結合多種管弦樂器的聲響。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「symphonic」？
options: The film used symphonic music with a full orchestra.
The car had a symphonic wheel after the tire broke.
The classroom was symphonic because it had blue walls.
She bought a symphonic sandwich from the cafe.
optionExplanations: 正確。電影配以管弦樂團演奏的交響樂，搭配自然。
錯誤。輪胎壞掉不會產生「交響樂式車輪」。
錯誤。牆壁是藍色與交響樂無關。
錯誤。三明治並非交響樂風格的作品。
questions.explanation: 正確。電影配以管弦樂團演奏的交響樂，搭配自然。

questions.meaning: 電子的；靠電子設備運作的
questions.usage: 常形容電子郵件、電子設備或電子音樂。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「electronic」？
options: The bread turned electronic after we warmed it.
The river was electronic because the water was cold.
We bought an electronic ticket on the website.
My dog became electronic after a short walk.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。加熱麵包不會使它變成電子設備。
錯誤。水溫低並不表示河流是電子的。
正確。網站上買電子票券，搭配正確。
錯誤。散步不會使狗變成電子的。
questions.explanation: 正確。網站上買電子票券，搭配正確。

questions.meaning: 雕刻出來；切削成形（歌詞命令句）
questions.usage: carve 可指雕刻木頭、石頭；carve out 也可指開闢空間或機會。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「carve it out」？
options: The student carved out the book by reading it.
She carved out a small bird from a piece of wood.
The artist carved out the rain with a blue pencil.
The driver carved out the bus to get to work.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。讀書並不等於把書雕刻成形。
正確。從木頭雕出小鳥符合 carve out。
錯誤。雨水不能當木材般雕刻。
錯誤。開公車上班應說 drove the bus。
questions.explanation: 正確。從木頭雕出小鳥符合 carve out。

questions.meaning: 賣力奔忙；催促；（依語境亦可指騙取）
questions.usage: 正式中性情境常指積極做事、快步移動；有時帶負面意義，需看上下文。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「hustle」？
options: She hustled her breakfast to put it in the fridge.
We had to hustle to catch the last train.
The museum hustled its windows to turn them green.
I hustled the blue sky to make it cloudy.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。把早餐放冰箱應說 put it in the fridge。
正確。趕末班火車需要加快腳步，語意合理。
錯誤。hustle 不是把窗戶變色的動詞。
錯誤。不能靠 hustle 使天空變陰。
questions.explanation: 正確。趕末班火車需要加快腳步，語意合理。

questions.meaning: 麵團；（俚語）錢
questions.usage: 烘焙時表示麵團；非正式口語也可指錢。歌詞使用金錢的俚語義。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「dough」？
options: I need more dough to buy the concert ticket.
The baker used dough to repair the broken brakes.
The coach washed the dough to clean the team shirts.
She used some dough to make her phone ring.
optionExplanations: 正確。買票需要更多錢，dough 的俚語義自然。
錯誤。dough 若指麵團，不能修理煞車；若指錢則應交代支付修理費。
錯誤。麵團不能當洗衣精。
錯誤。麵團／錢不能用來使手機響。
questions.explanation: 正確。買票需要更多錢，dough 的俚語義自然。

structure.title: 句型研習
structure.note: 依提供的核對版材料編排；保留原有教學範圍。

questions.meaning: 現在的狀況與之前發生的事情有關。
questions.usage: 談到目前已經完成或造成現況的經歷。
questions.prompt: 館長已收到三份新照片，哪句最能表達「到現在已經收到」？
options: The museum to receive three photos next year.
The museum receiving three photos yesterday.
The museum has received three photos today.
The museum receive three photos tomorrow.
optionExplanations: to receive 不能單獨作整句的述語。
缺少助動詞，不能單用 receiving 作述語。
has received 是現在完成式，連結今天的進展。
缺少限定動詞，且 tomorrow 是未來。
questions.cue: I've had a little bit too much
questions.explanation: has received 是現在完成式，連結今天的進展。

questions.word: a little bit too much：程度過量
questions.meaning: 帶點輕描淡寫地表示「有點太多」。
questions.usage: 覺得鹽、工作量或時間稍微超過理想程度。
questions.prompt: 陶藝家在黏土中加了太多水，哪一句最貼切？
options: I added little bit very much water.
I added a little bit too water.
I added a little bit too many water.
I added a little bit too much water.
optionExplanations: very much 無法如此接在 little bit 後。
too 後缺少 much 或形容詞。
water 不可數，不能用 many。
too much water 指水加過量。

pattern.text: 不可數量或語境已知之事

questions.explanation: too much water 指水加過量。

questions.meaning: 指出某個群體的全體成員。
questions.usage: 談特定團隊、觀眾或參加者全員。
questions.prompt: 展覽閉館時，工作人員全數離開，哪句適合？
options: All of the staff leaves yesterday.
All of the team leave tomorrow yesterday.
All of the visitors left the museum.
All of visitor left the museum.
optionExplanations: 昨天應用 left，且複數主詞不配 leaves。
tomorrow 與 yesterday 衝突。
all of the visitors 表示全部參觀者。
all of 後缺少限定詞或複數形。
questions.explanation: all of the visitors 表示全部參觀者。

questions.meaning: 表示開始進行某動作。
questions.usage: 開始下雨、開始移動或開始排隊。
questions.prompt: 海豚表演結束，觀眾開始離場，哪句最自然？
optionExplanations: 缺少限定動詞且 left 不能跟在 to 後。
to 後應接 leave 原形。
start 後面在本句缺少 to。
started to leave 是開始做某事。
questions.explanation: started to leave 是開始做某事。

questions.word: can’t + 動詞原形：不能做到
questions.meaning: 表示沒有能力或無法完成動作。
questions.usage: 找不到東西、看不清或做不到時。
questions.prompt: 魔術師找不到舞台鑰匙，哪句合適？
options: The magician can’t find the key.
The magician can’t to find the key.
The magician can’t found the key.
The magician can’t finding the key.
optionExplanations: can’t find 正確。
can’t 後不加 to。
found 是過去式，不能直接跟在 can’t 後。
情態動詞後不可用 finding。
questions.explanation: can’t find 正確。

questions.word: 特殊疑問句：Where + be + 主詞？
questions.meaning: 詢問人或物所在的位置。
questions.usage: 尋找工具、朋友或物品時。
questions.prompt: 你在木工教室找不到護目鏡，應問哪句？
optionExplanations: Where are + 名詞是正確問句。
直接問句須將 are 放在主詞前。
do 與 are 在這裡不能並用。
所有格 my 的位置錯誤。
questions.explanation: Where are + 名詞是正確問句。

questions.word: 一般過去式：已完成的過去事件
questions.meaning: 敘述過去發生且已結束的事情。
questions.usage: 回憶昨天的意外或活動。
questions.prompt: 昨晚攝影師遺失鏡頭，哪句正確？
options: The photographer losing a lens last night.
The photographer loses a lens last night.
The photographer lost a lens last night.
The photographer has lose a lens last night.
optionExplanations: 缺少限定動詞。
last night 搭配一般過去式較合適。
lost 是 lose 的過去式。
has 後需 lost，且明確過去時間不適合此用法。
questions.explanation: lost 是 lose 的過去式。

questions.word: What’s going on?：正在發生甚麼
questions.meaning: 詢問眼前發生甚麼事。
questions.usage: 看到突然的動靜或混亂。
questions.prompt: 動物園企鵝突然全部跑向水池，你會問甚麼？
optionExplanations: be + going on 構成進行中的狀況詢問。
缺少 is。
going 不可改成 go。
副詞位置不自然。
questions.explanation: be + going on 構成進行中的狀況詢問。

questions.meaning: 前後出現轉折或反差。
questions.usage: 一件事好、另一件事不如預期。
questions.prompt: 天文台夜空清楚，但望遠鏡壞了，哪句最好？
options: The sky is clear, and clear telescope broke.
The sky is clear, but the telescope is broken.
The sky is clear, because the telescope is broken.
The sky is clear, so telescope never clear.
optionExplanations: 第二部分不成自然子句。
but 自然對比好天氣與壞設備。
because 表因果，未呈現預期的對比。
so 暗示沒有根據的因果且語法有問題。
questions.cue: I love this record, baby, but I can't see straight anymore
questions.explanation: but 自然對比好天氣與壞設備。

questions.meaning: 表達從前可以、現在不再如此。
questions.usage: 習慣或能力發生改變時。
questions.prompt: 舊戲院已經不能再放映電影，哪句自然？
options: The old cinema is anymore showing films.
The old cinema shows anymore films.
The old cinema didn’t anymore cinema.
The old cinema doesn’t show films anymore.
optionExplanations: anymore 放在這裡不自然。
anymore 不這樣修飾 films。
結構破碎，沒有清楚動詞受詞。
否定句尾的 anymore 表不再。
questions.explanation: 否定句尾的 anymore 表不再。

questions.meaning: 直接發出要求、指示或邀請。
questions.usage: 請同伴做一件具體事情時。
questions.prompt: 電影導演請燈光師開燈，哪句是正確命令句？
options: To turn on the lights, please.
optionExplanations: Turn on 是動詞原形開頭的指示。
命令句不採第三人稱單數 turns。
to-infinitive 不是完整命令句。
-ing 片語不是完整命令句。
questions.explanation: Turn on 是動詞原形開頭的指示。

questions.word: Wish + could：希望有能力改變現況
questions.meaning: 對當下不能做到的事表達希望。
questions.usage: 希望能參加活動、會一種技能但目前不會。
questions.prompt: 博物館導覽員不會說法文，想和遊客溝通，哪句貼切？
options: I wish I could to speak French.
I wish I can spoke French.
I wish I could speak French.
I wish I could speaking French.
optionExplanations: could 後不加 to。
can 後面不能用 spoke，且未使用想像式 could。
wish I could speak 表達目前做不到的願望。
could 後要原形。
questions.cue: Wish I could shut my playboy mouth
questions.explanation: wish I could speak 表達目前做不到的願望。

questions.word: How’d + 主詞 + 動詞原形：口語回顧
questions.meaning: 驚訝地問先前怎麼會發生某件事。
questions.usage: 發現物件放錯或自己做了意外的事。
questions.prompt: 廚師發現把糖放進鹽罐，哪句能問「我怎會這樣做」？
options: How’d did I put sugar in the salt jar?
How’d I put sugar in the salt jar?
How’d I putted sugar in the salt jar?
How’d I to put sugar in the salt jar?
optionExplanations: How’d 已含 did，不再加 did。
How’d (= how did) 後用 put 原形。
did 後不能再用 putted。
did 後不使用 to put。
questions.cue: How'd I turn my shirt inside out?
questions.explanation: How’d (= how did) 後用 put 原形。

questions.meaning: 把物件的內外面翻過來。
questions.usage: 衣服翻面或把袋子裡外翻轉。
questions.prompt: 裁縫檢查衣服內側縫線，哪句最自然？
options: She turned the jacket inside out to check it.
She turned inside out the jacket to check it.
She turned the jacket to inside out.
optionExplanations: turned the jacket inside out 正確。
inside out 不是動詞。
受詞放在動詞與 inside out 之間更符合此教學句型。
inside out 前不需 to。
questions.explanation: turned the jacket inside out 正確。

questions.word: 一般現在式陳述普遍事實
questions.meaning: 表達普遍成立的事實或規律。
questions.usage: 描述自然、科學或固定現象。
questions.prompt: 自然課要說「蜜蜂有翅膀」，哪句正確？
optionExplanations: 缺少限定動詞。
had 是過去式而 tomorrow 是未來。
have 表示一般事實。
複數 bees 應搭配 have。
questions.explanation: have 表示一般事實。

questions.word: they say：傳聞訊息的插入語
questions.meaning: 表示「人們這麼說」，訊息未必是自己的觀察。
questions.usage: 引用坊間流傳的觀點或說法。
questions.prompt: 朋友說那座橋晚上很漂亮，你想標明是聽來的，哪句適合？
options: The bridge is beautiful at night, they to say.
The bridge is beautiful at night, they say.
The bridge is beautiful at night, they says.
The bridge is beautiful at night, they saying.
optionExplanations: to say 在這裡不構成小句。
they say 是可放句尾的插入語。
they 要配 say 而非 says。
缺少 are，並非完整小句。
questions.explanation: they say 是可放句尾的插入語。

questions.meaning: 表示正進行或近期安排的狀況。
questions.usage: 談現在正在準備或正在做的事。
questions.prompt: 劇團正在搭建舞台，哪句正確？
options: The actors is building the stage now.
The actors building the stage now.
The actors are building the stage now.
The actors are build the stage now.
optionExplanations: 複數 actors 應用 are。
缺少 are。
are building 構成進行式。
are 後需 building。
questions.explanation: are building 構成進行式。

questions.meaning: 指出行動發生的時間條件。
questions.usage: 描述每次進場或抵達後會做什麼。
questions.prompt: 保育員每天進入鳥舍就檢查水，哪句最自然？
options: When I entering the bird room, I check the water.
When enter I the bird room, I check the water.
When I enters the bird room, I check the water.
When I enter the bird room, I check the water.
optionExplanations: 缺少 am，這不是現在式動詞。
語序錯誤。
主詞 I 搭配 enter。
when 後是完整現在式子句。
questions.cue: When I come through on the dance floor
questions.explanation: when 後是完整現在式子句。

questions.meaning: 表示沒有某物或某種狀況。
questions.usage: 描述沒有噪音、錯誤或協助的情況。
questions.prompt: 雕塑家獨自完成作品，哪句符合「沒有助手」？
options: She finished the statue without a helper.
She finished the statue without was helper.
She finished the statue without help to.
She finished the statue without to helper.
optionExplanations: without a helper 是沒有助手。
without 後不能直接接 was。
help to 在此不完整。
without 後不能直接用 to helper。
questions.explanation: without a helper 是沒有助手。

questions.meaning: 表示觀察後明白或察覺一件事。
questions.usage: 從結果看出某人準備好或情況改變。
questions.prompt: 花店員工發現花已開，哪句自然？
options: I can see that the flowers to open.
I can see that the flowers open are.
I can see that are the flowers open.
I can see that the flowers are open.
optionExplanations: 缺少限定動詞。
be 動詞位置錯。
that 後不能用疑問倒裝。
that 後接正常陳述語序。
questions.cue: I can see that you got so much energy
questions.explanation: that 後接正常陳述語序。

questions.meaning: 強調很多的數量或程度。
questions.usage: 形容精力、時間、耐心等不可數事物。
questions.prompt: 志工為社區花園付出許多時間，哪句正確？
options: They gave so much times to the garden.
They gave so many time to the garden.
They gave so much time to the garden.
They gave so much a time to the garden.
optionExplanations: times 在此表次數而非時間量。
time 不可數時使用 much。
so much time 正確。
不可數 time 不加 a。
questions.explanation: so much time 正確。

questions.word: there is no + 名詞 + why 子句
questions.meaning: 表示找不到某件事不能做的理由。
questions.usage: 討論計畫有沒有障礙或理由。
questions.prompt: 天氣晴朗、路線安全，哪句最適合說沒有理由取消野餐？
options: There is no reason why we canceling the picnic.
There is no reason why do we cancel the picnic.
There is no reason why to cancel the picnic.
There is no reason why we should cancel the picnic.
optionExplanations: why 後缺少完整限定動詞。
間接從句不倒裝。
why 後在此需完整子句，不是 to-infinitive。
no reason why + 陳述語序正確。
questions.cue: there is no reason at all why you can't leave here with me
questions.explanation: no reason why + 陳述語序正確。

questions.meaning: 表示在另一件事發生之前的這段時間。
questions.usage: 等候演出、交通或活動開始時。
questions.prompt: 火車半小時後到，你可以先逛展覽，哪句恰當？
options: The train leaves in thirty minutes. In the meantime my time yesterday.
The train leaves in thirty minutes. In the meantime, visit the gallery.
The train leaves in thirty minutes. I bought an in the meantime.
The train leaves in thirty minutes. In the meantime is a gallery.
optionExplanations: 後半句不成完整英文句子。
in the meantime 正確表示等待期間先做別的事。
不是可數物品。
時間片語不能直接作名詞。
questions.explanation: in the meantime 正確表示等待期間先做別的事。

questions.word: let + 受詞 + 原形動詞
questions.meaning: 讓某人做某件事；此句的 watch 後還有感官動詞結構。
questions.usage: 請求允許自己觀看或參與活動。
questions.prompt: 小孩想幫忙給植物澆水，哪句符合？
options: Let me to water the plants.
optionExplanations: let 後用原形動詞。
let 的受詞用 me。
let 後直接用 water，不能加 to。
let me water 正確。
questions.cue: let me watch you break it down
questions.explanation: let me water 正確。

questions.word: watch + 受詞 + 原形動詞
questions.meaning: 觀看某人完成或進行一項動作（著眼整個動作）。
questions.usage: 觀察人表演、工作或完成任務。
questions.prompt: 你從頭看到尾，見證舞者完成一套動作，哪句合適？
options: I watched the dancer finished the show.
I watched the dancer finish the show.
I watched the dancer to finish the show.
I watched the dancer finishes the show.
optionExplanations: finished 不是這裡的原形。
watched the dancer finish 正確。
watch + 人 + 原形動詞不加 to。
不能接 finishes。
questions.explanation: watched the dancer finish 正確。

questions.meaning: 程度足以讓某事發生。
questions.usage: 物件距離、大小或能力足夠完成任務。
questions.prompt: 孩子站得夠近，能看見昆蟲，哪句正確？
options: She is enough close to see the insect.
She is close enough to see the insect.
She is close enough seeing the insect.
She is close enough to seeing the insect.
optionExplanations: enough 應放在 close 後。
close enough to see 表示距離足以看見。
需 to-infinitive 而非 seeing。
to 後用動詞原形。
questions.cue: stay close enough to get it on
questions.explanation: close enough to see 表示距離足以看見。

questions.word: spend + 金錢 + 地點／目的
questions.meaning: 花費金錢；此處 dough 是非正式「錢」。
questions.usage: 買材料或服務、談預算時。
questions.prompt: 手作市集有人花掉剩下的零錢，哪句正確？
options: They spent their last coins at the craft fair.
They spend to the last coins at the fair.
They spent on the last coins without anything.
They spent the last coins yesterday tomorrow.
optionExplanations: spent their last coins 表花掉最後的零錢。
spend 直接接金錢，不接 to。
花的是 coins，而 spent on the coins 變成買硬幣。
昨天與明天矛盾。
questions.explanation: spent their last coins 表花掉最後的零錢。

questions.meaning: 請對方不要做某件事。
questions.usage: 安全提醒、舞台指示或日常提醒。
questions.prompt: 陶器剛上釉，老師提醒大家別碰，哪句正確？
options: Don’t to touch the wet paint.
optionExplanations: don’t 後不能用 touching。
don’t touch 是正確否定命令句。
don’t 後不加 to。
don’t 後不能用 touches。
questions.explanation: don’t touch 是正確否定命令句。
